AlphaGap signed dashboard, SubnetRadar public feed and dated briefs, TAO Daily and TAO Media, official releases and 186 repository paths reviewed. Partnership counterparties checked where identifiable.

accessGaps: Research cutoff 2026-10-08T15:58:12.068Z. No complete X archive, private Discord access or Grok scan is claimed; associated public-account samples and selected signed searches are not exhaustive per-subnet name/SN searches.

13 repository paths returned errors and 10 account candidates yielded no usable sample. Directory aliases can be stale. TAO Daily’s Hippius tag page returned 500; the relevant article and primary documentation were reachable.

Generated briefs and AlphaGap summaries were discovery sources. SN14 Cacheon revenue, SN23 Trishool experiment, SN105 Beam access changes and SN102 Connito AI customer lead remain developing where original records or rollout were unavailable. Community allegations were not upgraded to verified facts.

SN51 lium.io’s new OpenTensor Foundation report describes April–September billings and buybacks; exact burn transactions and the separate October 5,000 TAO claim were not reconstructed. SN41 Almanac figures are team reports, not independently audited accounts.
SN71 Leadpoet’s investment amount and terms are undisclosed; a separate counterparty investment announcement was not found in the sampled feed.
SN58 Attune’s invitation is visible but its parent post was deleted. Vector/Horizon status comes from the project site; no launch context was invented from the deleted post.

SN108 ChipForge still displays zero validator agreement and no daily payout figure. SN78 UMI’s API still says rewards_active:false and chain_submission_authorized:false. SN116 Carbon’s public material remains development/testnet rather than a verified production reward launch.
SN91 Cascade, SN62 Ridges, SN33 ReadyAI and SN18 Zeus performance figures are scoped team reports, not independently reproduced benchmarks or demonstrated financial returns.

Subtensor owner-control code is merged, but Finney runtime activation was not verified. Pool lending remains an open proposal. Code, winning records and dashboard state do not by themselves prove live reward settlement.
No new upcoming Shizzy stream appeared in the sampled Live tab. The completed SN91 Cascade stream is retained as a replay; removed or postponed Cat, VUNE and older Cascade URLs remain excluded.

decisions.reason: Weekly +75.764602% alpha/TAO triggered focused signed X discovery. A current builder invitation, live Vector and upcoming Horizon were checked against the primary site and miner rules. The parent post was deleted; no fresh Horizon launch or causal price explanation inferred.

Day -16.291750% / week +184.115798% alpha/TAO triggered a live browser leaderboard check. 53 submissions, 26 miners, eight winner records, UID64 score2067.34 and threshold2274.08 are new progress; zero-of-five agreement and blank reward field are not payout proof.

Day -26.278818% alpha/TAO triggered current directory, dated brief and TensorUSD repository review plus a focused LongShort search. The associated legacy repository had no window commits, the brief reported spam rather than a product or incident announcement, and name search also matched unrelated stock traders. No primary catalyst or ownership event was established; do not invent one from price.

Day -17.417393% / week +1617.524381% alpha/TAO triggered Carbon README, project-status and fresh 237-commit review. New commitment-fact, customer-input and miner-interface engineering remains development work; production readiness, hosted battery acceptance, payable winners and paid customers are not established. October7 already covers the registration/launch-claim distinction. Weekly price spans October4 registration/identity change and is not Carbon business performance.
